q: How long can a bank take to decide on my MSME loan application?
title: How long a bank can take on an MSME loan
short: For a micro or small enterprise asking for up to Rs 25 lakh, RBI says the credit decision shall not take more than 14 working days. For larger loans the bank's own Board-approved sanction time norms apply, and every bank must publish its timelines on a separate MSME tab on its website.
audience: MSME owners waiting on a term loan or working capital decision, and branch officers handling them

p: RBI's Master Direction on lending to the MSME sector, updated on 9 February 2026, says the timeline for credit decisions on loans up to Rs 25 lakh to micro and small enterprise borrowers shall not be more than 14 working days. Above that amount, the bank follows its Board-approved sanction time norms. The direction is addressed to scheduled commercial banks, other than regional rural banks; if your lender is an NBFC, a cooperative bank or a regional rural bank, ask which rule it follows.
A medium enterprise is outside the 14-day line, which is written for micro and small units. Its timeline is the bank's own published norm.

ul: Every MSME application, on paper or online, must get an automatic acknowledgement with a unique application serial number from the bank's Credit Proposal Tracking System. Status updates are also meant to reach you automatically. Keep that number.

Banks must give you an indicative checklist of documents when you apply. Ask for it on day one, submit everything on it, and get the branch to confirm by email that the file is complete. RBI's text does not say when the 14 days start, so a complete file with a dated acknowledgement removes the argument.

p: Banks must show all MSME credit information, including timelines for credit decisions and the document checklist, under a separate tab on their website. They must also publish, each quarter, how many applications stayed pending beyond their sanction time norms, within a month of the quarter ending. If your loan is above Rs 25 lakh, that tab is where your deadline is written.

sections.h: If the bank goes past it
ol: Write to the branch manager with your application serial number, the date your file was complete and the timeline that applies.
Escalate to the bank's grievance redressal or nodal officer named on its website.
If there is no reply within 30 days, or the reply does not resolve it, complain under the Reserve Bank Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 at cms.rbi.org.in.

sections.h: What the deadline does and does not give you
p: It gives you a decision, not a yes. If the bank rejects the loan, it must tell you the main reasons in writing within its sanction time norms. Use those reasons: a rejection for missing evidence can be fixed and resubmitted, for example on a green or energy loan where the bank wants proof of the saving.

example.title: Same unit, three applications
lines: Rs 18 lakh term loan for a new machine, small enterprise: decision within 14 working days
Rs 60 lakh loan for a rooftop solar plant, same unit: the bank's Board-approved norm, read it on the bank's MSME tab
Rs 18 lakh loan to a medium enterprise: the bank's Board-approved norm
14 working days in calendar terms: roughly three weeks once Sundays and the second and fourth Saturdays are taken out, longer if bank holidays fall in between

senseible: On a green or energy loan, a file can stall while the bank waits for proof of your energy use. Senseible reads your electricity bills and fuel invoices into monthly energy and carbon figures you can hand over with the application, and its green loan check shows what else a credit team will look for. The decision and its timing stay with the bank.

sources.label: RBI Master Direction, Lending to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Sector, updated 9 February 2026, paragraphs 4.4 (14 working days up to Rs 25 lakh, website tab) and 4.7 (Credit Proposal Tracking System, checklist, pendency disclosure, reasons for rejection)
RBI, Reserve Bank Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (rbi.org.in)

reviewNote: Terms change. Check the current RBI Master Direction on MSME lending every quarter; the 14-day limit and the Rs 25 lakh threshold may be revised.
